Image 2 shows the preceding page-turn drawings; CONTINUE from its bottom-right pose, in which ONE page has just crossed the notebook center toward the left. Image 3 is the exact canonical writing pose to return to. Same registered character scale/position in all cells; same squirrel with acorn cap, backpack and curled tail, tree mug. Keep head, face, expression, eyes, ears, torso, tail, hat/backpack and mug STILL. Thin warm hand-painted 2D storybook outlines. Both arms stay connected. Covers, book bottom edge and binding never shift. One held pencil only. Read cells left-to-right then next row: cel18 the paper sweeps farther left and begins falling, about 40px above the left page; cel19 paper 30px above left page; cel20 paper settles to 15px above left page; cel21 the thin paper finishes settling flat on the LEFT side of the notebook, free paw gently releases it; cel22 free paw returns near its canonical right-page resting place as the writing paw lowers pencil toward the left page; cel23 EXACTLY the canonical writing pose from Image 3, pencil tip touching the left page, free paw resting on right side, notebook flat. This creates a continuous page-turn then handwriting loop. No extra or flying leaves, no book or body movement, no enlarged hands, no duplicate paws or pencil. True alpha transparency. No room, desk, shadows, captions, numbers, borders, grid lines or layout changes.
